description: Turn site photos into a captioned, branded Word or PDF report that records site conditions or completed repairs.
pricing: $25 CAD one-time purchase per user, no subscription. Free download; a license code unlocks it. 14-day refund policy.
notes: ReportRivet is a Windows desktop app for documenting site conditions with photos. A property manager can import photos from a walkthrough, sort them by area (Roof, Exterior, Common areas), caption each one, and export a dated Word or PDF report with their company's logo. Two common uses: recording a building's condition before a capital project or lease change, and a before-and-after record that verifies a contractor's repair before the invoice is approved. It works offline, projects stay on your computer, and original photos are never changed. Windows 10 and 11. Sample report: https://reportrivet.pages.dev/#sample. Submitted by the maker, Marcus Gerrard.
